theme: a wedding house where one guest has no shadow
fmt: told in first person by someone who lived through it ('that night I...'), as if sharing a true experience
title: ছায়াহীন অতিথি: বিয়ের বাড়ির অশুভ রাত 🩸
summary: Anirban arrives at his ancestral mansion in Birbhum to attend his cousin Riya's grand wedding. Amidst the bright decorations and joyful music, he notices an unfamiliar guest named Shib-da, whom everyone assumes belongs to the other family's side. However, Anirban notices horrifying anomalies: Shib-da leaves no footsteps, casts no shadow under bright petromax lamps, and has no reflection in old mirrors. As night falls and a sudden blackout hits the mansion, Anirban and his friend Suman discover a 50-year-old wedding album showing Shib-da—a groom who vanished mysteriously on his wedding night in 1974. Before they can escape, Shib-da traps them in the dark corridor.
part2_plan: In Part 2, Anirban and Suman attempt to unlock the hidden basement beneath the inner courtyard where Shib-da's remains were secretly buried fifty years ago. They must perform an ancient ritual before the auspicious wedding hour ends, while Shib-da hunts them down room by room through the pitch-black mansion.

characters.name: Anirban
characters.look: 25-year-old Bengali man, medium height, short black hair, wearing a beige silk kurta and white pajama, carrying a brass flash lantern with a worried face.

characters.name: Suman
characters.look: 26-year-old cheerful Bengali man, wearing a bright yellow kurta, short neat hair, friendly expression, holding a smartphone.

characters.name: Shib-da
characters.look: 38-year-old tall, unnervingly pale man wearing a traditional crisp white silk dhoti-kurta. Hollow sunken dark eyes, pitch-black hair combed slick back, unnaturally static cold smile.

setting: An ancient 19th-century Zamindar mansion in Birbhum, West Bengal, decorated with marigold flowers and flickering petromax lamps for a wedding. High ceilings, cracked lime-plastered walls, dark long corridors, and a central open courtyard surrounded by carved wooden pillars.

choice.question: অনির্বাণের এখন কী করা উচিত?
choice.option1: সুমনকে টেনে নিয়ে ওখান থেকে পালানো
choice.option2: পুরোনো অ্যালবামের রহস্য নিয়ে প্রেতকে মুখোমুখি প্রশ্ন করা
choice.plan1: Anirban tries to drag Suman toward the main gate, but the ghost seals all exits with thick black shadows, forcing them into the ancient altar room.
choice.plan2: Anirban holds up the 1974 photograph and confronts Shib-da, triggering a terrifying wrath that reveals the true tragedy of that cursed night.
